name: Silver State Wire & Cable Inc
old_description: The Lacing Tape Dispenser is made with the ease of use in mind. It helps keep your workbench organized, without having loose rolls of lacing tape rolling around in the workspace. Made of sturdy materials for use in the aerospace industry work environments. It feeds lacing tape to the technician with a weighted base to help prevent wasted material during the installation process.
about:
Silver State Wire & Cable Inc. began in 1991 in Sparks, Nevada, as a woman‑owned small business. It started as a modest value‑added service provider with two employees and three 1950s‑era wire processing machines, cutting and kitting wire, cable, and tubing for local assembly houses and OEMs.

Today the company provides wire processing, cable assembly, wiring harness fabrication, crimping, and electronic component testing, along with supply‑chain services such as kitting and just‑in‑time delivery. It also manufactures proprietary products including the Lacing Tape Dispenser, BRAIDLITE™ lightweight braided shielding for space applications, and the SumiMark IV Plus thermal‑transfer marking system. The operation serves programs ranging from hobby aircraft to satellites and fighter jets.

Silver State’s customer base spans aerospace, space, defense, and general aviation. Clients include OEMs building satellites, prime contractors rewiring fighter jets, and smaller shops assembling experimental aircraft. The company emphasizes on‑time delivery of exactly what each application requires, whether a single prototype or production quantities.

The firm cites its AS9100 and ISO 9001 certifications, ITAR registration, and WOSB status as foundations of its quality system. Management states that supporting customers remains the core of the business, with continuous improvement aimed at better service and reliable delivery for every order.
